tools.name: discard_gap
tools.description: Delete a draft gap from the store. Only a draft can be deleted; a submitted gap is kept forever.

gap_id.description: the ID of the draft gap

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Return the whole document with the given ID, for reading full tables or following links. IDs come from search results and list_docs.

tools.name: glossary_terms
tools.description: List the terms the glossary defines, each with its name, abbreviation, defining document ID, heading anchor, and plain-text definition, optionally filtered by a substring of the term.

term.description: keep only terms whose heading contains this text, ignoring case; omit for every term

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List the ID and title of every document in the corpus.

tools.name: list_gaps
tools.description: List recorded documentation gaps, optionally filtered by status (draft, open, kb, resolved, duplicate, wontfix) and by a substring of the SRD reference.

status.description: filter by status: draft, open, kb, resolved, duplicate, or wontfix; empty returns all

srd_ref.description: keep only gaps whose srd_ref contains this text, for example an SRD document ID

tools.name: mark_gap_kb
tools.description: Mark an open gap as covered by the knowledge base, recording the KB document that states the fact while the published documentation does not. The gap leaves the open backlog and can still be resolved once a documentation page is published.

gap_id.description: the ID of the gap to mark

kb_ref.description: KB document ID stating the fact, optionally with a section anchor

tools.name: report_gap
tools.description: Record a documentation gap hit while authoring an SRD: content that is missing, wrong, incomplete, or ambiguous. Returns the new gap ID. With draft set the gap is recorded unconfirmed, in draft status, to be edited with update_gap and then confirmed with submit_gap or dropped with discard_gap. This only captures the gap; the fix is published to the documentation by hand later.

kind.description: one of missing, wrong, incomplete, ambiguous

topic.description: short label for the missing knowledge

doc_id.description: related corpus document ID from a search or get_doc result, empty when none is relevant

heading_path.description: section heading path, copied verbatim from a result

source_url.description: canonical URL, copied verbatim from a result

demand.description: why the gap blocks the SRD work at hand

target_claim.description: the specific fact the documentation should state

detail.description: what is missing, wrong, incomplete, or ambiguous

search_terms.description: queries tried, so a reviewer can tell absent content from unfindable content

srd_ref.description: the SRD location that raised the gap

draft.description: record the gap unconfirmed, in draft status; omit to record it open

tools.name: resolve_gap
tools.description: Mark an open or kb gap resolved, recording the URL of the documentation page authored or edited by hand to cover it.

gap_id.description: the ID of the gap to resolve

published_url.description: URL of the documentation page authored or edited to cover the gap

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the documentation corpus and return the most relevant sections with citations. Retrieval only; no LLM.

k.description: maximum number of results, 1 to 100; omit for 10

tools.name: submit_gap
tools.description: Confirm a draft gap, moving it to open status so it enters the documentation backlog.

gap_id.description: the ID of the draft gap

tools.name: update_gap
tools.description: Replace the descriptive fields of a draft gap with the given ones; fields left out become empty. Only a draft can be edited.

gap_id.description: the ID of the draft gap to edit

kind.description: one of missing, wrong, incomplete, ambiguous

topic.description: short label for the missing knowledge

doc_id.description: related corpus document ID from a search or get_doc result, empty when none is relevant

heading_path.description: section heading path, copied verbatim from a result

source_url.description: canonical URL, copied verbatim from a result

demand.description: why the gap blocks the SRD work at hand

target_claim.description: the specific fact the documentation should state

detail.description: what is missing, wrong, incomplete, or ambiguous

search_terms.description: queries tried, so a reviewer can tell absent content from unfindable content

srd_ref.description: the SRD location that raised the gap
